headline: A key sizing habit is impacting your results.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The cost of this habit was ₹1,05,732. It happened in 96 after‑loss trades where the median entry size after a loss was ₹12,562 versus the usual median of ₹6,578, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. Those trades resulted in a loss of ₹1,95,375, with an after‑loss win rate of 28% compared with a 39% win rate otherwise.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: Adding to losing positions is starting to appear and is worth watching.

closing: Consider applying the rule “After a loss, your next entry is your usual size” next month.
